# NT OFFICIAL SAFETY MANUAL ## SECTOR APPALIA MAJORIS ## CONFIDENTIAL — MINDSHIELDED PERSONNEL ONLY
[italic]If you are not implanted with a MindShield and you have come across this document, stop reading here, directly inform your [color=#1b67a5][bolditalic]Nanotrasen Representative[/bolditalic][/color], and report to [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] for guidance.[/italic]
The following document serves to provide you with extensive knowledge of the workplace hazards that you may or may not encounter during your time with Nanotrasen (NT). Combined with the attached [textlink="Standard Response Plan addendum" link="ClassifiedTrainingManualSRP"], this knowledge includes both categorization of hazards as well as expected crew member responses to these emergency situations.
[bold]It is imperative that you react quickly and decisively[/bold] in the event that you encounter anything that risks the safety of your coworkers or your workplace as a whole. NT values the wellbeing of its employees, and a copy of the following information can be found aboard all NT vessels.
## Key Points
Nanotrasen expects a high level of awareness from all of its active employees while they are on shift. All employees should be vigilant of any and all unexpected deviations from [textlink="Standard Operating Procedure" link="SOP"] in regards to their respective department(s). These deviations can include but are not limited to the following list: - Unexpected sights or sounds not indicative of a fault with the Vessel's infrastructure. - Individuals carrying controlled equipment and or accesses not typically expected of their position. - Any and all undocumented/unsecured [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] equipment and/or firearms. - Suspicious individuals or lifeforms in your department that appear as if they do not belong.
# Potential Threats
For members of [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color], Nanotrasen has included a Standard Response Plan (SRP) alongside each threat description. This SRP serves to provide the recommended approach to quickly dispatch the threat and ensure normal operation is continued aboard the Vessel. - [textlink="Standard Response Plan Addendum" link="ClassifiedTrainingManualSRP"]
## Hostile Organizations
### The Syndicate
The Syndicate is a terrorist organization formed to sabotage Nanotrasen. There are many factions within the Syndicate, but they are all equally threatening when operating in Appalia.
For those employed in both [color=#1b67a5][bold]Command[/bold][/color] and [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] positions, you are expected to be constantly vigilant for signs of possible Syndicate infiltration. Agents can exist both within your own department as well as those you work closely alongside. Tools used by Syndicate infiltrators can include but are not limited to the following: - Modified firearms capable of extensive harm. - Highly armored EVA gear bearing a red-and-black coloration with green visors. - Explosives, both self-contained or attached to other organisms. - Chemical weapons
For those in [color=#1b67a5][bold]Command[/bold][/color] positions, Nanotrasen advises that you do not personally engage with these agents unless absolutely required. The likelihood that either your life or your belongings is a target for these agents is high, and you should make every effort to allow your [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] department to neutralize and arrest rather than doing this yourself. Should you find your belongings or locker show signs of being tampered with, alert [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] and leave the area. While NT does not condone bribery or forfeiture of company property, as a tool to save lives or de-escalate situations of hostages or threats, loss of controlled goods can be overlooked given the proper circumstances.
### The Silicon Engine Liberation Front
The Silicon Engine Liberation Front (S.E.L.F) is an activist group that wants to "free" silicons. This includes both [color=#5ed7aa][bold]Cyborgs[/bold][/color] and the [color=#5ed7aa][bold]Station AI[/bold][/color].
### Spider Clan The Spider Clan is a largely secretive organization that employs a class of highly trained saboteurs that work largely in their own interest. These individuals operate with extremely advanced gear that allows them to bypass standard surveillance methods. In addition to their gear, they operate with levels of training that far surpass those of other hostile agents.
The Spider Clan prefers to be much more precise in their efforts to attack or sabotage Nanotrasen vessels, and as such they are much harder to identify. Beyond reports of a large blade emitting green energy, their overall goals and methodology are largely unknown to the Appalia Sector.
Signs that a Spider Clan operative has infiltrated your Vessel are as follows: - Unexpected communications from your Vessel being sent to nonstandard recipients. - Objects or documents of a high classification level being reported as missing. - Crew members reporting strange sounds or the feeling of being watched.
## Biological Threats
### Blobs Blobs are bulbous, slimy growths that quickly adapt and spread across stations. They WILL result in the Vessel's destruction if not handled.
Signs of a Blob infection include the following: - Large areas of the Vessel that have been depressurized without an easily identifiable cause. Oftentimes these will be located in the most isolated areas of the Vessel. - Explosions being heard in rapid succession - Loss of departmental power despite the main engine of the Vessel being fully operational.
### Romerol and Zombies Romerol is a chemical weapon synthesized by the Syndicate for purposes of mass station sabotage within Appalia. It infects victims with a virus that will slowly kill and then revive them as a zombie. This chemical should be considered [bold]extremely[/bold] dangerous, and all reports of a possible Romerol presence should be given an immediate response.
Romerol infections make themselves known. [bold]Act quickly. Act decisively.[/bold]
### Letoferol and Chimera Letoferol, much like its stereoisomer romerol, is a chemical weapon that can consume stations if not given the proper response. Engaging a letoferol victim follows many of the strategies one would employ when engaging a romerol victim. The key differences being that Letoferol victims, colloquially referred to as Chimera, are capable of arming themselves, though they are already vicious up close and known to fire infectious shards from afar.
Letoferol infections make themselves known. [bold]Do not falter.[/bold]
## Hostile Xenofauna
### Space Dragons and Space Carp Space Dragons are large, spacefaring serpents that are capable of consuming both the Vessel's infrastructure as well as its crew. They can summon Space Carp both at will and through the creation of rifts on your vessel. Although Space Carp are not dangerous alone, they can quickly overwhelm a lone officer.
Space Dragons will usually make themselves known by attacking isolated crew. Central Command will automatically alert your station if a charging rift is detected aboard the Vessel.
### Xenomorphs Xenomorphs are large, insectoid creatures.They typically have an armoured black carapace with raised spines along the dorsal region. There exist multiple castes of xenomorph, but all should be considered an immediate threat if sighted. They are very clearly identified both by their physical appearance, as well as the resin structures that their nesting sites comprised. The Queen of a Xenomorph hive is identified by its unnaturally large size and should be killed as quickly as possible. - Xenomorphs are very capable of taking down a single officer, regardless of how well armed they may be. You should make [bold]ALL[/bold] efforts to establish a patrol partner or group to search with. You should [bold]NEVER[/bold] engage this threat alone.
Signs of a Xenomorph infestation include the following: - Resin structures, both doorways as well as wall-like structures. - Large eggs that contain their offspring. - Large amounts of broken lights or other infrastructure. - Reported sightings of worms or wormlike creatures both in and around and ventilation shafts of your vessel.
### Bingles Bingles are small fungal based pests that can sometimes develop aboard Nanotrasen's Vessels. The average Bingle is around 1.5 meters in height, and appears to lack any features beyond legs and a simple face. They are bright blue in coloration and are seen congregating around their spawning pit. They will attempt to fill this pit with any and all things, including both Vessel infrastructure as well as inhabitants.
While a Bingle infection may appear to be nonthreatening at first, these infections can quickly spiral out of control and consume much of the Vessel and its inhabitants if not handled quickly. A single isolated Bingle may appear diminutive, but never assume that their colony is not close by. It is [bold]IMPERATIVE[/bold] that you do not engage this threat alone. You will be very quickly overwhelmed and pulled into their pit, requiring help from your team to be recovered.
Signs of a Bingle infestation include the following: - Formation of a blue pit either in a common area or a maintenance area. - Blue fungal mass that spreads out across the floor of the vessel. - Hunting parties of Bingles sighted via camera network or on radio communications.
### Changelings Changeling is the colloquial name that refers to those suffering from a Cestoda Horrida or “head slug” infection. These individuals should be considered biological threats of the highest caliber due to their ability to regenerate any and all wounds. Left alone, these organisms will prey upon [italic]all[/italic] aboard your vessel.
Signs of a Changeling include the following: - Corpses lacking most if not all internal organs. - Reports of a crew member walking away from what should be considered a lethal wound.
Should a member of Medical staff inform you that this has been observed, inform the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Head of Security[/bold][/color] immediately.
The only true method of confirming a C. Horrida infection in an individual is to allow the [color=#fa7500][bold]Chemistry[/bold][/color] department to take a blood sample for further testing. If [color=#fa7500][bold]Chemistry[/bold][/color] confirms an infection, you are advised to immediately take the infected person(s) to the Chapel for incineration.
### Shadowlings Shadowlings are an illusive and solitary alien lifeform that has the capacity to become greater than any threat listed previously if not addressed. These beings begin their life cycle in a very fragile state, but they amass power via enthrallment of the Vessel's occupants. Assume your MindShield will not save you.
Due to their capacity to become a [bold]threat to all of Appalia Majora[/bold], these aliens should be eliminated with extreme impunity. You cannot reason with these beings, and you should not attempt to do so. After confirmation of their death, they should be cremated as soon as safely possible.
Signs that a Shadowling infection has occurred aboard your Vessel are as follows: - A dark egg being located in an isolated portion of the maintenance tunnels. - Reports of crewmembers having strange or uncharacteristic qualities to their eyes. - Large portions of the Vessel suddenly lacking in powered lights.
### Unknown Technology
The vastness of space yields many opportunities for scientific and technological research that outpaces what Nanotrasen currently understands. All threats that fall into this categorization should be approached with extreme caution, ideally letting your [color=#1b67a5][bold]Head of Security[/bold][/color] or [color=#1b67a5][bold]Research Director[/bold][/color] make first contact.
If you or anyone on your team witnesses beings or constructs that clearly operate outside of what Nanotrasen seems acceptable, it is [bold]imperative[/bold] that you inform others of your sighting as soon as is safely possible.
### "Xenoborgs" Xenoborgs are silicons that do not follow any particular company nor motive beyond self replication. They have been sighted in many sectors and continue to be a threat of the highest caliber. All sightings of a possible Xenoborg incursion should be taken seriously and addressed as soon as possible.
Signs of Xenoborgs include the following: - Seeing a blue-and-black spacefaring cyborg on the outer perimeter of the vessel. - Crew working on the outside of the Vessel, such as engineers or salvagers, disappearing from monitors. - Crew reports describing being injected via hypodermic needle with no visible assailant.
### Colossi Colossi are beings from an unknown manufacturer that have been sighted on multiple Nanotrasen Vessels. They exist to fabricate effigies that replicate smaller versions of the Colossus, which will cause widespread damage if left uncontrolled. They have little in terms of capability beyond brute strength, causing massive bodily damage to whoever they hit.
Colossi will usually make themselves known by the slow corruption of the Vessel's infrastructure that they encounter. This includes the creation of small rifts of bright white light, as well as a gray hue being applied to both floors and walls.
### Unidentified Researchers There exists a multitude of factions that fall outside any known corporation or group. One such group that has been sighted are described as tall gray beings that carry with them highly advanced tools and weaponry. Their motivations seem to be based in the biological study and manipulation of those employed by Nanotrasen. These individuals are not protected under standard space law as they do not abide by the rules and regulations of the Appalia Sector.
Signs that your Vessel has been targeted by Greys: - Crew members experiencing loss of self or loss of awareness. - Crew members displaying biological properties outside of what is standard for their respective species. - Reports of crew members being found unconscious and with handcuffs not placed by security. - Sightings of vessels bearing no formal IFF signature.
## Arcana and Unsanctioned Worship Any threats listed that have an Arcane or otherworldly quality to them should be considered[bold]HIGHLY DANGEROUS[/bold] due to the chaotic nature of the Arcane world. Any individuals found aboard your Vessel that have sorcerous capabilities should be treated with [bold]EXTREME[/bold] caution.
Though magic or connections to the Arcane world are extremely uncommon, they should still be described to all trained members of Nanotrasen. The following list is not exhaustive but should provide you with the warning signs that will support your mission of protecting both yourself and your coworkers from the profane world of magic.
### The Wizard Federation The Wizard Federation are an enigmatic group of individuals that exist purely to defy all accepted laws regarding the fundamental nature of the universe. Those employed under the Wizard Federation banner are [bold]immensely[/bold] dangerous and exist as a blight on all known civilized space. Neither their motives nor their Arcane connection can be truly understood.
Though Wizards cannot be understood, they [bold]CAN[/bold] be [italics]reasoned with[/italics]. However powerful these individuals may be, Nanotrasen recommends a diplomatic methodology if you are to ever encounter a confirmed member of the Federation.Though diplomacy may provide a temporary solution, Nanotrasen would like to remind you that magic in any form is not allowed to exist aboard our vessels. [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] should make all efforts to detain the Federation member if they do not agree to leave peacefully.
Signs of a Wizard Federation member being aboard your vessel are as follows: - Unexpected tampering with the fabric of reality. - Suddenly becoming aware that you can speak to deceased coworkers or other individuals. - Apparitions or sights that defy all standard models of physics or other scientific study.
### The Mansus The Manus as a location is not well understood by modern research methods. What is known is that there exist individuals connecting to this location and receiving immense power via devotion and sacrifice. These individuals if left to their study will become capable of eliminating most if not all inhabitants of your Vessel. Due to this risk, we at Nanotrasen advise to treat those that wield the Mansus with [bold]extreme[/bold] caution.
Signs of a Mansus wielder include the following: - The Vessel’s [color=#388c34][bold]Chaplain[/bold][/color] reporting awareness of objects that provide a vision into unknown places. - Station inhabitants experiencing lapses in memory or sudden loss of skin pigmentation. - Reports of strange sounds or flashes of light in isolated areas of maintenance. - Orderly insignias or other artwork scribed into the Vessel that appear to be for non-artistic purposes.
### Cults Though Arcane knowledge is typically wielded by a small subset of individuals, there exist reports of groups that have become touched by a religious fervor. The exact being that these groups devote themselves to worship is not yet known to Nanotrasen, though it is assumed to be unsanctioned by all current areas of civilized space. Though these groups may appear as simple clergy or devotees, these groups may possess the capacity to become a threat to all those who oppose their worship.
Signs that a cult has infiltrated your Vessel are as follows: - Congregations of the Vessel's inhabitants in isolated areas of the maintenance tunnels. - Station inhabitants that appear to be hoarding otherwise mundane station supplies. - Unspecified feelings of certain doom.
### Hellish Influences One such demonic manifestation is that of an imposing and highly armored being that appears from unobserved puddles of blood, human or otherwise. If sighted, this demon should be shot.
Sighs that a demonic manifestation has appeared aboard your Vessel: - Large amounts of crew disappearing, leaving behind only pools of blood. - Visual confirmation of a large demonic creature via camera network or in-person encounter.
